**必填**，来自「上传图片」（用途选「封面」）。没有封面图微信直接拒收: **Required.** Comes from “Upload image” (with purpose set to “Cover”). WeChat rejects the draft outright without a cover image
JPG/PNG；封面图 ≤10MB，正文配图 ≤1MB（微信的限制）: JPG/PNG; cover image ≤10MB, inline image ≤1MB (WeChat's limits)
success 成功 / publishing 发布中 / original_f: success / publishing / original_failed (originality declaration failed) / audit_failed (review rejected) / …
一般不用填（微信在境内）。填了要注意：**白名单认的是出口 IP**，走代理后出: Usually not needed (WeChat is reachable domestically). If set, note that **the allowlist checks the egress IP**, so behind a proxy the egress IP is the proxy's
两条路的产出不一样：封面要 media_id，正文要地址: The two purposes produce different results: a cover needs a media_id, inline content needs a URL
公众号后台「设置与开发 → 基本配置」里的开发者 ID: The developer ID from the official account backend, under “Settings & Development → Basic Configuration”
关掉则只提交任务、立刻返回 publish_id（拿不到文章链接）。微信的发布是: When off, this only submits the job and returns publish_id immediately (no article URL). WeChat publishing is asynchronous: a successful submission doesn't mean a successful publish — it can still stall on an originality declaration or platform review
同一页的开发者密码。**只在生成时显示一次**，丢了只能重置（重置会让旧的立刻失: The developer secret from the same page. **It is shown only once, at generation time** — if lost, it can only be reset (which immediately invalidates the old one)
封面图 → media_id；正文配图 → 微信域名的图片地址（外链图在正文里显: Cover image → media_id; inline image → an image URL on WeChat's domain (externally hosted images won't render in the body)
微信域名的地址，拼进正文 HTML 的 <img src>: A URL on WeChat's domain, to put in the body HTML's
把一篇文章写进公众号草稿箱，产出 media_id。可在后台肉眼复核后再发布: Writes an article into the official account's draft box and returns a media_id. You can review it manually in the backend before publishing
把文章写进草稿箱、发布、拿到永久链接。国内唯一一条「API 正经、金融内容可做、: Writes articles into the draft box, publishes them, and returns a permanent link. The only domestic channel with a proper API, that allows financial content, and has broad enough reach.
把草稿发出去并等到发布完成，产出文章链接。**发出的文章不进历史消息**，是永久: Publishes a draft and waits for it to finish, returning the article URL. **Published articles don't appear in message history** — the link is permanent
换一次 access_token 并查草稿数——顺带验出「IP 不在白名单」与「: Refreshes the access_token once and checks the draft count — this also catches the two most common pitfalls: “IP not allowlisted” and “account lacks publish permission”
支持基础 HTML；**不支持 script/iframe/外部样式表**。正文: Supports basic HTML; **script/iframe/external stylesheets are not supported**. Images in the body must first go through “Upload image” to get a WeChat-domain URL — externally hosted images never render
文末「阅读原文」跳转的地址: The URL that “Read more” at the end of the article links to
最多 120 字；留空则微信截正文前 54 字: Up to 120 characters; if left empty, WeChat truncates the first 54 characters of the body
查阅读量等数据接口要用它: Needed for querying read-count and other analytics APIs
用途选「封面」时有值，绑到「建草稿」的封面图上: Set when purpose is “Cover”; bind it to the cover image in “Create draft”
等到完成才有；可直接点开或发进通知: Only available once finished; can be opened directly or sent in a notification
